title: Elastic Stack 9.5.6 released
summary:
Version 9.5.6 of the Elastic Stack was released today. We recommend you upgrade to this latest version. We recommend 9.5.6 over the previous versions 9.5.5

For details of the issues that have been fixed and a full list of changes for each product in this version, please refer to the release notes.

These releases contain security fixes. For details, refer to the Elastic Security Advisories at https://discuss.elastic.co/c/announcements/security-announcements/31.

title: How Elastic helps Audi Revolut F1® Team find what matters across engineering software
summary: We are excited to announce a new multi-year partnership between Elastic and Audi Revolut F1® Team. The partnership builds on an existing technical relationship: the team already uses Elastic to support investigations across its engineering software.

title: Elastic looks to speed up Jina Model Inference by 8x using NVIDIA RTX GPUs
summary: Elastic is accelerating Jina model inference with NVIDIA RTX Pro 6000 GPUs, delivering up to 8x faster embedding, 4x faster reranking, and 3.7x faster OCR to power search and agentic AI.
